topic: Classifying Substances as Elements and Compounds
key_concepts: Substances are classified into elements and compounds.
Elements are pure substances that can exist alone.
Compounds form when elements join in a chemical reaction.
A chemical bond holds elements together in a compound.
Compounds can be broken apart by an electrical current.
Oxygen, iodine, calcium, iron, and potassium have specific body functions such as breathin
Water, sodium chloride, hydrochloric acid, aspirin, and methane have daily uses such as dr
Table salt is composed of one sodium atom and one chlorine atom.
Carbon dioxide is a compound because it is made of two different elements.
Heating sugar produces a black mass and water, showing sugar is a compound.
Chemical symbols represent elements, and chemical formulas show the atoms in compounds.
